name: @socio/push-relay
description: Socio's push relay: a Cloudflare Worker that forwards end-to-end encrypted Web Push to APNs and FCM. Registrations, the Web Push receiver, quotas, and the APNs and FCM clients.

scripts.dev: cross-env WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false DO_NOT_TRACK=1 WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler dev --local
scripts.migrate:local: cross-env WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false DO_NOT_TRACK=1 WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
